harnessFailures.detail: 7z was unavailable; 7zz and 7za were also unavailable. No listing or full bundle closure verification claimed. Fixed actual installer hash, PE and Nullsoft header, source license and installed COPYING were independently checked.

Direct Python 3.9 reported non-UTF-8 before executing the report script. An ASCII runner strictly decoded the same original bytes as UTF-8 and compiled them successfully, then wrote records. Frozen source and receipt bytes were unchanged.

Python 3.9 datetime.fromisoformat rejected nanosecond UTC Z timestamp strings. Verification stopped before staging or commit. Corrected only the host parser to compare UTC seconds and exact nanosecond integers; all nine checkpoint known-time comparisons then passed.

Before commit, git diff --cached --check treated exact CRLF in the two DOS-generated RESULT.TXT.bin evidence files as trailing whitespace and stopped. Added only scoped whitespace=cr-at-eol to this DOSBox binary-evidence attribute, retaining -text and all actual output bytes. Default staged check must pass before commit or push.
